flaws_identified.description: Historical paired comparison engine mechanically performed rowwise subtraction of squared errors: delta_se = (y - pred_a)^2 - (y - pred_b)^2 and passed this to summarize_delta_distribution labeled as 'delta_rmse'. This computed Delta_MSE (mean squared error difference, e.g. 53.5946 min^2) rather than Delta_RMSE (root mean squared error difference, ~1.25 min). Furthermore, model_a_mean and model_b_mean were populated with MAE rather than RMSE.
flaws_identified.repair_description: RMSE is now evaluated as a non-linear aggregate metric on unit of inference 'fold_population'. True RMSE is computed for Model A and Model B globally, and paired aggregate bootstrap resamples units to evaluate the empirical distribution of Delta_RMSE = RMSE_A - RMSE_B.

flaws_identified.description: Historical code fabricated observation-level R^2 contributions via formula r2_contrib = 1.0 - (se_i * n) / SS_tot and performed observation-level subtraction. R^2 is a non-linear ratio of global sums; pseudo-observation subtraction distorts the sampling distribution and standard errors.
flaws_identified.repair_description: R^2 is now computed as a global aggregate metric. Confidence intervals and two-sided p-values are generated by paired aggregate bootstrap over resampled units.

flaws_identified.description: Historical summary documents claimed universal statistical significance (p < 0.001) across all comparisons without formal multiplicity adjustment across the 40 pairwise comparisons per task family (10 model pairs x 4 folds). Furthermore, empirical bootstrap with 2,000 replications cannot resolve p-values below ~0.001 without asymptotic extrapolation.
flaws_identified.repair_description: Implemented explicit pre-registered Holm-Bonferroni step-down correction across comparison families. Bootstrap p-values are strictly bounded by [2 / (B + 1), 1.0]. Zero unverified p-value claims permitted.

flaws_identified.description: Prior documentation blurred the distinction between 'stationary block bootstrap' (Politis & Romano, 1994, geometric block lengths) and 'day-level cluster bootstrap' (resampling calendar days).
flaws_identified.repair_description: Formally separated and implemented four distinct resampling schemes: iid_percentile, day_cluster_percentile, fixed_block_percentile, and stationary_block_percentile with explicit mathematical definitions and 'why_this_unit' justification.

flaws_identified.description: The previous schema lacked explicit declaration of the unit of inference, leaving ambiguity whether statistics applied to individual flights, operational days, folds, or simulation runs.
flaws_identified.repair_description: Added InferenceUnit enum ('flight', 'fold_population', 'day_cluster', 'scenario_x_seed', 'outer_replication') and made it a mandatory field in every comparison record.
